strategy.title: No executable plan: one buyer at $4,800 cannot carry $15,000
strategy.why: The only opening is a single organisation (Meridian Regional Health System) with one evidenced $4,800 purchase order; one organisation is not a population of buyers, and even a won deal reaches at most $4,800 of the $15,000 target, with close rate unknown.

alternatives.title: Sell the credentialing workbook to Meridian alone
alternatives.why: Caps at $4,800 (32% of target); conversion not evidenced; the cited PO was already awarded 2026-10-02.

alternatives.title: Sell the same workbook to other hospital systems
alternatives.why: No count of reachable comparable buyers, price or conversion is evidenced; research question cnd_5d21fe2af5bd4cb7b596 is open.

steps.label: Count reachable hospital systems buying vendor-credentialing audits through a published channel, with prices paid

quantities.name: buyerVolume
quantities.needs: A published count of hospital systems that buy credentialing audits and can be reached, with prices

quantities.name: closeRate
quantities.needs: A live offer to the procurement office

sources.claim: Meridian Regional Health System's procurement office issued a $4,800 purchase order for a vendor-credentialing audit (award notice, 2026-10-02).
sources.population: Meridian Regional Health System only (one organisation)

noPlan.decisiveGap: MARKET_VOLUME: the evidence describes one buyer (Meridian) at $4,800, so the most any plan can reach is $4,800 of $15,000; no population of comparable reachable buyers is evidenced.
noPlan.resolution: Research the number of reachable hospital systems buying vendor-credentialing audits and their prices (question cnd_5d21fe2af5bd4cb7b596), aiming for at least 4 buyers at ~$4,800 within the 45-day settlement window; or lower the target to $4,800.

constraints.suggestion: Lower the target to $4,800 (one Meridian deal) unless research establishes more buyers.
